render_schematic_from_npy: render a numpy schematic file in a Minecraft world using cuberite and output vision images
render_world_without_schematic: render a Minecraft world without a schematic by using spawn position and default yaw angles
run_render_with_custom_yaws: run the render function with custom yaw angles to capture images from specific viewpoints
compute_ground_height: compute the ground height of a block array by finding the layer with the most dirt blocks
convert_yaw_pitch_to_unit_vector: convert yaw and pitch angles in degrees to a 3D unit direction vector for camera positioning
